evidence.decision: Chooses least immersion per activity, separating contained windows, actual 3D inspection and deliberate Full Space moments instead of defaulting to immersion.
evidence.artifact: Requires task-to-presentation map plus storyboard or revised implementation, entry/return state and resting/alternative input paths.
evidence.transformation: Pottery catalog places browsing/notes in Shared Space and vase in a volume with indirect rotation, reserving optional surrounding exhibit for deliberate entry and stateful return.
evidence.verification: Walks complete task; fails unnecessary immersion, lost return context, repeated reach/turn and unstable motion; reserves comfort/targeting claims for worn-device verification.
evidence.applicability: Qualifies flat-mockup evidence, Crown control, room-permission boundary, posture/reach and 13+/hazard scenarios; distinguishes relative placement from rigid head locking.
evidence.handoffs: Full Space requires immersive-experiences; spatial layout, eyes, accessibility and shared presence are loaded only when their respective task conditions exist.
evidence.distinctiveness: Presentation-per-moment and physically sustainable resting input define a concrete spatial workflow that is distinct from the detailed immersive-experiences or layout topics.
